ledger: large glass bail-top jar | empty, centered on cutting board, wire hinge on its right side | ~half full of olives, same board position, hinge still frame-right | progressively filled; position and orientation never change

small glass container/ramekin | held above jar mouth, full of olives, tilted pouring | emptied and carried off frame-right ~00:00:04, returns refilled ~00:00:05.5, emptied again by 00:00:09 | motion continuous, re-enters on the same side it exited
stainless steel bowl | on counter right of jar, full of green olives | same location throughout | contents scooped from (state change, out of scope); bowl never moves
white ceramic bowl with dark rim | far right of counter, heaped with olives | same location at right/bottom-right edge | stationary; partially cropped as camera orbits
small clear bottle | not visible in opening frames (occluded behind white bowl) | visible right of steel bowl from ~00:00:04.0 onward | revealed by camera parallax, geometrically consistent

stove/oven | background center: knob row, oven handle, dark window | background right-of-frame as camera orbits; cooktop grates visible from higher angle | same appliance, perspective shift only; window glow is lighting (out of scope)
wooden cabinet banks | right of stove in opening view | drawer bank appears frame-left in later frames | consistent with camera orbiting west; wood base visible at frame-left edge from start
cutting board | under jar, distinctive stain right of jar base | identical stains, identical position | stationary anchor; confirms no set rearrangement
person | standing behind counter, arms raised over jar | same standing position | reaches right to steel bowl, scoops, returns to pour — all emergences on correct sides

camera | frontal view of person/jar/stove | orbited leftward and slightly raised by end | smooth continuous move; background pans right in frame revealing west counter (honey jar, yellow wall) — parallax direction is consistent
